aligned_texts: Wei Ming, 22, from Malaysia, is a third-year Bachelor of Business student at Monash University's Clayton campus. He works part-time at a retail store in Chadstone and is the unofficial social coordinator of the share house. An ENFJ, Wei Ming is extraverted and community-minded, often organizing group dinners and outings, but he also values his privacy and needs alone time to recharge. Despite his cheerful and calm exterior, he struggles with high anxiety and depression, which he manages with a daily routine that includes backing up files and re-reading texts. He is cautious about safety and finances, yet adventurous in his choices, and he is deeply committed to his family, wealth, personal freedom, and spirituality. Wei Ming is highly conscientious about some things (always early, detailed) but has very low conscientiousness in others (irregular sleep, impulse buying). He is skeptical of free markets and government regulation, positive on climate action, and a nuclear energy enthusiast. He avoids alcohol and smoking, follows a flexitarian diet, and rarely exercises. He has a dog back home and misses it. In the house, he is the one who insists on consensus for decisions, but his low sympathy and empathy can make him seem distant when others need emotional support. He is a laggard with technology, uses an iPhone, pays cash, and prefers Telegram. He has an attention condition and mild motion sensitivity. His daily habits include monthly meditation, weekly phone-free downtime, and daily file backups. He is a complex mix of high extraversion and high anxiety, making him both the glue and the worrywart of the household.

Priya, 21, from India, is a second-year Bachelor of Arts student at Monash Caulfield, majoring in Art History and Creative Writing. She works part-time at a local café and is known for her vibrant, artistic energy. An ENFP with high neuroticism, Priya is a strong extrovert who loves big groups and seeks excitement, yet she is risk-averse and highly cautious about health and safety. She is devoutly religious, practicing Hinduism daily, and values health, creativity, independence, and helping others. Priya is intellectually curious and open-minded, with a signature appreciation for beauty and a strong sense of hope. However, she struggles with anxiety and depression, and her mental health is a constant challenge. She has reduced manual dexterity, which makes some tasks difficult, and follows a medical dietary restriction. She is a free spender and impulse buyer, yet she is cost-sensitive overall and keeps a weekly budget. She is a night owl who drinks high amounts of caffeine, cooks daily, and keeps her room tidy. Priya is an early adopter of technology, though she is skeptical of new tech, and she uses a mix of devices. In the share house, she is the one who initiates spontaneous adventures and deep conversations, but she can also be directive and competitive. She has a car and drives to campus. She is apolitical but has strong opinions on free markets and government regulation. Her habits include daily stretching, weekly reading before bed, and weekly doomscrolling. She never volunteers but cares deeply about others. Priya's presence brings warmth and creativity, but her emotional volatility requires patience from her housemates.

Tharindu, 23, from Sri Lanka, is a fourth-year Bachelor of Engineering student at Monash Clayton. He works part-time as a tutor and at a supermarket, and he is the eldest caregiver for his grandmother back home, which adds to his stress. An ISFJ with high conscientiousness, Tharindu is a natural leader who always takes charge, but he is also frustrated and vulnerable, with very low trust and high depressive symptoms. He is a devout Buddhist and values wealth, personal freedom, adventure, tradition, achievement, creativity, community, knowledge, and integrity. He is risk-tolerant in health and safety but financially risk-averse. He is an enthusiast for nuclear energy and opposes renewables. He has a mild mobility limitation, poor sleep, and takes daily medication. He is chaotic in tidiness but always on time, and he is a saver who cooks daily and walks everywhere. He has a cat. Tharindu is gregarious and active, yet he has very low agreeableness and sociability, which can make him seem abrasive. He is highly productive and competitive, and he always leads. In the share house, he is the one who organizes chores and rent, but his frustration and high stress can lead to conflict. He is mainstream in technology adoption, uses Android, and prefers Instagram and Messenger. His habits include weekly meditation, weekly morning walks, and weekly nail-biting. He is a complex figure: dependable yet difficult, caring yet distant, and he struggles with his own mental health while caring for others.

Linh, 20, from Vietnam, is a second-year Bachelor of Science student at Monash Clayton, majoring in Chemistry. She works part-time as a lab assistant and is the most introverted and anxious member of the house. An ISFJ with high neuroticism, Linh is analytical, dutiful, and highly conscientious, but she also experiences very high anxiety, anger, and emotional volatility. She is deeply spiritual (Buddhist) and values career success, wealth, creativity, community, loyalty, recognition, and order. She is left-leaning and has strong moral foundations of care, fairness, and loyalty. She is an early adopter of technology, a subscription enthusiast, and an EV enthusiast. She has strong motion sensitivity and a diagnosed attention condition. She is a night owl who never cooks, rarely travels, and works freelance from home. She is a frugal saver but a free spender in some areas, and she is a researcher shopper. She doesn't drink alcohol or smoke, follows an ethical diet, and has poor sleep. In the share house, Linh is reliable and dutiful, but her low cheerfulness, low modesty, and low respectfulness can make her critical and difficult to live with. She values privacy and order, yet she is spontaneous and competitive. She uses Windows, Safari, and Telegram, and she pays with a mobile wallet. Her habits include weekly to-do lists, weekly stretching, weekly gratitude, and weekly hydration tracking. She struggles with mental health and has low cognitive load capacity, so she needs a calm environment. Despite her challenges, she is deeply caring and sympathetic, and she volunteers monthly. Her presence adds a serious, spiritual, and intellectually curious note to the household.

Chen, 24, from China, is a first-year Master of Business Information Systems student at Monash Clayton. He works part-time as an IT support assistant and is the most easygoing and cooperative member of the house. An INTP with high agreeableness, Chen is friendly, gregarious, and highly cooperative, but he has very low conscientiousness and productiveness, often procrastinating and skipping breakfast daily. He is spiritually inclined (Taoist) and values family, career success, wealth, knowledge, justice, sustainability, fun, and equality. He is very liberal, cautious about safety, and has very low emotionality, though he experiences high stress and poor general health. He is an early adopter of technology and an enthusiast for data privacy, but he is skeptical of climate action and renewables. He is unbanked and uninsured, which reflects his financial precarity. He is a spender, brand loyal, and uses public transit. He has a dog and enjoys daily morning walks and reading before bed. He is collaborative, prefers to follow, and is always open to novel experiences. In the share house, Chen is the one who mediates conflicts and goes with the flow, but his lack of conscientiousness means he often forgets chores and deadlines. He has mild attention issues and motion sensitivity. He uses Android, Chrome, and WhatsApp, and he pays cash. His habits include daily morning walks, daily reading before bed, weekly naps, and weekly cold showers. He is a gentle, forgiving presence, but his financial and health struggles require support from his housemates. He is the heart of the house, bringing humor and humility.
